findings.first_safe_sprint_reason: R1 adds observability (evidence_dir always created) and a non-degradation baseline check — purely additive changes. No generation or publisher code is touched. Cells 9/9 and Words 4/4 cannot regress from R1 changes. R1 also produces the denominator model artifact that all subsequent sprints depend on.
what_must_not_be_done_next: Do not expand Words allowed_types before R3 denominator model exists (coverage claims become unverifiable)
Do not touch code_generator.py and github_pr_publisher.py in the same sprint
Do not enable TC14 production posting (R8) before test reproducibility is confirmed stable (R7+)
Do not create PDF PR #4 (Optimizer) before Optimizer LLM rerun passes (R6)
Do not merge any PR without post-merge validation gate passing
Do not mark any taskcard CLOSED_VERIFIED without source evidence file citation

Verify evidence_dir exists after a run without --metrics flag
Verify release-status.json has cumulative_pr_count field with correct value
